description:
VB.Net Developer  
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a VB.Net Developer for a contract opportunity in New York, NY.
 

 VB.Net Developer Job Details 
 

 Responsible for the analysis, design, development, implementation and maintenance of in-house applications.
 

 Responsibilities include: 
 

 Maintain, develop, test, debug and install our in-house developed applications. 
 Prepare technical specifications according to business functional specifications.
 Assist with the development of project plans.
 Research and analyze reported maintenance requirements.
 Lead team of programmers, business analysts and users throughout the project life cycle.
 Assist end users and business analysts in the resolution of technical problems related to system functions, programming and procedures including providing off-hour support. Maintain issues list and facilitate resolution of issues.
 

 VB.Net Developer Mandatory skills 
 

 VB.Net Developer 6-10 years experience
 Experience in full SDLC required
 Experience with desktop client dev/test required
 Strong communication skills, a user-service orientation, familiarity with the team decision-making process and excellent problem-solving abilities.
 Financial industry experience is plus
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field
 Experience programming in VB.Net Framework, VBA and SQL
 Proven experience writing system documentation (design, test plans, test execution, implementation plans and implementation execution)
 Experience working from system requirements and design specifications through implementation
 Strong analytical and problem solving skills
 Ability to troubleshoot applications and identify root cause of defect
 Domain knowledge of Financial/Banking Institution methodologies is a plus
 Ideal candidate should have experience with VB.NET on batch processing and / or thick client projects
 **ON-SITE INTERVIEW REQUIRED.** 
 

 VB.Net Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 VB.Net Developer Assignment Length  
 

 12 Months


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
